en-US.author: Astral Software Inc.
en-US.description: An extremely fast Python type checker and language server, written in Rust.
en-US.name: ty
en-US.releaseNotes:
Bug fixes
- Improve generics solving when an intersection is passed into a generic call to prefer solving the call to a more precise type when it is safe to do so (#29578)
- Fix recursive type materialization (#29532)
- Infer return intersections from correlated call specializations (#28303)
- Preserve Self when checking universal protocols (#29207)
- Fix stack overflows involving recursive descriptor setter types (#29148)
- Preserve the namespace-package fallback in module discovery when the namespace-package fallback is obscured by a partial stub package (#29559)
- Report all missing @override decorators together (#29557)
- Fix false-positive invalid-argument-type diagnostics when inferring constrained type variables from callbacks that return an invariant generic with a gradual type argument (#29577)

Performance improvements
- Compare protocol receiver restrictions before binding (#29443)

LSP server
- Avoid cancelling requests for unrelated file changes (#29604)

Core type checking
- Generics solving: check for unsatisfiable bodies before existentially quantifying (#29504)
- Liskov diagnostics: Check inherited attribute conflicts (#28559)
- Return type inference: eneralize nested types in inferred return types (#29488)
